//: The owner's audition format (2026-11-26): one line, five styles, every voice. `instruction` steers models that take written directions (Gemini, Fish Audio); `tag` steers ElevenLabs, which acts from tags in the text.
line: Oh look, you made it. Grab a phone, pick a name, and try not to embarrass yourselves.

styles.label: Snarky
styles.instruction: Deliver it snarky: dry, sarcastic and eye-rolling, a smirk you can hear, leaning on the words for comic effect.

styles.label: Mean
styles.instruction: Deliver it mean: cutting, contemptuous and impatient, like the guests personally ruined his day. Harsh, but still funny.

styles.label: Indifferent
styles.instruction: Deliver it indifferent: flat, bored, low energy, a can't-be-bothered monotone with a little sigh in it.

styles.label: Nice
styles.instruction: Deliver it nice: warm, kind and gentle, genuinely glad to see everyone, like a favorite uncle.

styles.label: Cheerful
styles.instruction: Deliver it cheerful: bright, upbeat and bouncy, full game-show energy, grinning the whole way through.
